title: default=True on feature flags is order-sensitive
root_cause_summary: UNSET normalization for flag values was applied eagerly during option processing instead of being deferred. When --green appeared after --red, its default=True was overwritten by --red's UNSET default before normalization ran. Fix defers UNSET normalization to after all options are processed.
notes: Double-quoted strings are CLI option names like 'green', 'red'. Backtick strings include flag_value, default=True. Error Sources will find flag_value and UNSET in core.py. Behavioral ordering bug — harder to diagnose but good Agent 1 test.
